description:
Time-bucketed episode counts — the purpose-built answer to "how often is X discussed over time". Counts episodes matching the same filters as `particle_podcast_list_episodes` (person, company, entity, podcast, keyword, language, duration, transcript availability) per day, week, or month, plus range totals. `keyword_search` additionally counts matching transcript segments per bucket (exact counts); `semantic_search` does the same by meaning, with the same similarity threshold as `particle_podcast_search_transcripts` (lower bounds for pathologically broad queries), and requires `published_after`. The two cannot be combined.

Use this for appearance, publication, or topic trend lines instead of paging `particle_podcast_list_episodes`, `particle_podcast_find_mentions`, or `particle_podcast_search_transcripts` once per period. For how often a person, company or brand is mentioned, use `particle_podcast_get_mention_trends`: it leaves ad reads out, where this tool counts an episode for a company or entity named only in its ad reads, and it says which podcasts carried the mentions. Buckets are UTC-aligned, zero-filled, and Monday-aligned for weeks; ranges are capped at 1000 buckets. At least one of podcast_slug, person_slug, company_slug, entity_slug, keyword_search, semantic_search, guest_occupation, or guest_field is required.

The `guest_` filters count episodes by their guests' expertise (resolve the words to codes with `particle_expertise_resolve` first; on `unresolved_reference`, resolve and retry): `guest_field` alone charts how often a field's experts are booked; with `company_slug` it charts the company's episodes featuring those experts. They are episode-level and never check who spoke: with `keyword_search`, a matching segment counts when its episode had such a guest, even if the host said the words. For who said a keyword, use `particle_podcast_get_share_of_voice` with `keyword_search`.

company_slug.description: Company slug, domain, or ID. Resolves to the linked entity.

entity_slug.description: Knowledge-graph entity slug from particle_entity_resolve for the long tail that isn't a person or company (e.g. 'germany'). Use person_slug for people and company_slug for companies.

guest_capacity.description: Only episodes with a guest who knows their field in this capacity (e.g. 'executive_founder' for founders). It narrows the other filters; particle_expertise_resolve names the capacity an everyday word means.

guest_field.description: Only episodes with a guest listed under this ANZSRC 2020 field of research: a code, slug or title from particle_expertise_resolve (e.g. 'banking-finance-and-investment').

guest_in_field.description: Only episodes with a guest speaking within their own field (the guest the other guest_ filters select, when given).

guest_occupation.description: Only episodes with a guest listed under this occupation: a SOC 2018 or ISCO-08 code, slug or title from particle_expertise_resolve, or a SOC group or everyday name (e.g. 'cardiologists', '29-1212', 'physicians' or 'doctors'). A word with no occupation filters by the field of research or capacity it names: 'oncologists' is field 3211, 'founders' is capacity executive_founder.

guest_practicing.description: Only episodes with a guest who still works in guest_occupation, which must be a SOC 2018 occupation or group (e.g. '29-1212' or 'physicians').

guest_seniority.description: Only episodes with a guest at this seniority or above.

guest_standing.description: Only episodes with a guest whose standing is recognized this way: 'established' (conferred by others), 'self_described', or 'unverified'.

has_transcript.description: Only count episodes with a completed transcript.

interval.description: Bucket width. Weeks start on Monday; all buckets are UTC-aligned. Defaults to week.

keyword_search.description: Keyword filter over transcript content. Double-quoted substrings must appear as exact phrases; unquoted terms must all appear in one transcript segment. Adds per-bucket mention counts to the response. Cannot be combined with semantic_search.

language.description: Restrict to episodes of podcasts in this language — ISO 639-1 code (e.g. 'fr'). Matches the podcast's primary language subtag, so 'fr' covers 'fr-FR'.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

person_slug.description: Person slug or encoded person ID (e.g. 'sam-altman'). Counts episodes featuring the person as a speaker — and, when the person has a linked knowledge-graph entity, episodes that mention them.

podcast_slug.description: Podcast slug, internal ID, or numeric iTunes ID. Restrict to one podcast. A particle.pro or Radar show link also works.

published_after.description: Inclusive range start as an ISO 8601 date or date-time. Omit to aggregate all time.

published_before.description: Range end as an ISO 8601 date or date-time. Defaults to now.

role.description: Role filter when person_slug, company_slug, or entity_slug is set.

semantic_search.description: Vector-similarity filter by meaning over transcript content — the counting twin of particle_podcast_search_transcripts' semantic_search, using the same similarity threshold. Describe the topic the way you'd say it to a colleague; paraphrase tolerant. Adds per-bucket mention counts to the response. Requires published_after (ranges up to ~2 years). Cannot be combined with keyword_search.

name: particle_podcast_get_episode_timeseries
title: Particle Podcast Get Episode Timeseries
